notes: The maister-relevant environment a Copilot hook actually sees: COPILOT_CLI_BINARY_VERSION (the version floor check), COPILOT_PROJECT_DIR (the git root the hook resolves .github/hooks from) and COPILOT_CLI. Repo hooks additionally require GITHUB_COPILOT_PROMPT_MODE_REPO_HOOKS=true or a trusted folder in headless -p mode.
